typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		COMPANY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_UNIT_CD as string,
		FAIL_QTY as string,
		BROKER_NSCC_CD as string,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR as integer,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		CUSIP_NBR as string,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		FAIL_AMT as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT_NBR as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		SETTLEMENT_DT as timestamp,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		TAG as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource1
OLEDBSource1 sink(input(
		COMPANY_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT_UNIT_CD as string,
		FAIL_QTY as string,
		BROKER_NSCC_CD as string,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR as integer,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		CUSIP_NBR as string,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		FAIL_AMT as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT_NBR as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		SETTLEMENT_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		TAG as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		COMPANY_CD,
		ACCOUNT_UNIT_CD,
		FAIL_QTY,
		BROKER_NSCC_CD,
		TAG_DPLCT_NBR,
		EFFDATE,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		CUSIP_NBR,
		INSTR_SPCL_CAGE_CD,
		ACCOUNT,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		FAIL_AMT,
		ORACLE_ACCT_NBR,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD,
		SETTLEMENT_DT,
		BRANCH_CD,
		CLIENT_NBR,
		TAG,
		ACCOUNT_CD,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
